answer_2.quote: We used two 'LLM-as-a-judge' systems and the Granite Guardian model as judge metrics for our experiments.

answer_3.quote: We adopted llama3.3:70b as our main LLM-as-a-judge system. We also used Granite Guardian as an additional judge.

answer_4.quote: We worked with four human evaluators (details in Appendix B) to judge bias of the model outputs.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators were instructed with the Bias Judge or NLI Judge prompts, which specified the bias assessment criteria.
